preservation.requiredPreparation: Inspect target face, subject mask and pose/face controls over every selected frame. Root must resolve an appearance input/mask/composite that protects source body/costume/tattoos. A shot-matched identity-edited still using the existing two-reference recipe is a possible input-preparation step, not already created; any preparation and its settings belong in the root preflight record. Do not run the full-subject template pretending an identity-only contract is already solved.

prompt: Use the supplied isolated Han Solo actor image for the lead face identity only. In the supplied Cantina toast excerpt, replace the lead man's facial identity with that likeness while preserving the same performance. Keep the source leather jacket, pale open shirt, neck chain, rings, grill, hairstyle treatment and every visible older face, neck and chest tattoo, including the older bird tattoo. This is an intentional Multiverse version; do not apply the current Prime Dolo tattoo or jewelry standard. Keep the glass, liquid level, hand grip, lift path, smile timing, head turn, camera movement, framing, other patrons, bar fixtures, neon/practical lighting and background action as in the source. Retain the source scene and expression; the actor reference supplies no wardrobe, prop, setting or tattoo instructions. Produce only the selected short excerpt, without a new cut, extension, added action, relighting, lip-sync rewrite or invented dialogue.
